# Dictionary.com

> > Dictionary.com provides comprehensive language resources including word definitions, thesaurus entries, interactive word games, and puzzle-solving tools.

Dictionary.com is a leading online dictionary and language reference platform offering lexicography resources, word-of-the-day features, and a suite of word-based games and tools including Anagram Solver, Word Search Maker, and Scrabble helpers. The site serves both casual users and word game enthusiasts through web and mobile apps (Android/iPhone).

## Key Topics

- Dictionary.com
- Lexicography
- Word-of-the-Day
- Anagram Solver
- Scrabble Word Finder
- Crossword Solver
- Word Search Maker
- Letter Unscrambler
- Word Game Tools
- Puzzle Generators
- Thesaurus
- Mobile Apps (Android/iPhone)
- Arkadium Games
- Word Finder Tools
- Puzzle Helpers

## Word Game Tools & Solvers

- [Anagram Solver Online - Free Online Game | Dictionary.com](https://play.dictionary.com/games/dictionary-anagram-solver): Anagram solver tool for unscrambling letters into words for games
- [Word Search Maker - Free Online Game | Dictionary.com](https://play.dictionary.com/games/dictionary-word-search-maker): Create printable word search puzzles with custom words
